courses.title: Dealing with Grief and Loss
courses.description: A guided breathwork meditation for moving through loss of many kinds: a death, a relationship, a pet or a chapter of life. It invites you to make room for the feelings that come with grief, including sadness that may have been carried down the generations.

courses.title: Freedom From Anxiety
courses.description: A guided breathwork meditation for times of anxiety, overwhelm or panic. Through conscious breathing and attention to where these feelings are held in the body, it teaches staying present with them rather than being carried away, and is meant to be returned to whenever anxiety starts to build.
